description: This file handles the process of merging duplicate 'Potential' records in a vtiger CRM system, including saving merges, transferring related records, and rendering merge fields with Smarty templates.

classes.name: vtigerCRM_Smarty
classes.description: Custom Smarty template class used for rendering views in vtiger CRM.

methods.name: transferRelatedRecords
methods.description: Transfers related records from duplicate entries to the primary record during merge.

methods.name: DeleteEntity
methods.description: Deletes a specified entity record after merging.

methods.name: getRecordValues
methods.description: Retrieves values from multiple records for display and comparison during merge.
